name: maintenance
title_zh: 记忆系统体检大夫，哪儿堵了当场给你通开
tagline_zh: 记忆延迟、捕获失灵、队列卡死、索引错乱——不用重装不用翻日志，它逐层排查抓出病灶，顺手把数据库和后台队列修到能跑。
tagline_en: When memory lags, capture fails, or the queue jams—skip the reinstall and log-diving. It probes each layer, finds.
desc_en: Check Codex Mem health and troubleshoot or repair its installation, capture, database, background queue, observation processor, or semantic index. Use when memory seems inactive, delayed, broken, or needs maintenance.
why_zh: 不是泛泛的『检查一下』，而是按捕获→入库→队列→观察器→语义索引的链路逐段诊断。
why_en: Not a vague 'check-up'—it walks the full pipeline (capture→DB→queue→observer→index), tells 'broken' from 'slow', and hands you.
limit_zh: 只针对 Codex Mem 自身（alexandrbasis/codex-mem）的安装与运行状态。
limit_en: Scopes to Codex Mem's own install & runtime—not memory content quality. If the fault lies in Codex core or your OS env, it can't see or fix it.
title_en: Memory system doctor that unblocks what's stuck
